snippet.title: From Ruins - Official Developer Overview | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Here's a look at the Developer Overview for From Ruins, a point-and-click detective mystery adventure game developed by DigiTales Interactive. Gather clues, solve puzzles, and make sense of what set off the end of the world in From Ruins, coming soon to PC (Steam).
